    GROUP BY a.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) > 2000
)

JOIN "Customers_Cards" cc ON cp.customer_id = cc.customer_id;

    SELECT cc.customer_id, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_paid
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
    HAVING total_paid > 2000

WITH customer_payments AS (

questions.nlq: Hey! Could you help me pull a list of the customers whose card dates are after 2016, showing their full name, the card number, and the total amount they've spent on payments? I'd love to see the top three spenders.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The phrase 'card dates' means the date the card became valid – the start date when the card was issued – not the expiration date.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
    cc.card_number,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customers_Cards cc
    ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft
    ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
WHERE cc.date_valid_from > '2016-12-31'
  AND ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, cc.card_id
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The phrase 'card dates' means the date the card expires – the end date when the card is no longer valid – not the start date.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
    cc.card_number,
    COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_payment_amount
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
    AND ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
WHERE cc.date_valid_to >= '2017-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, cc.card_id
ORDER BY total_payment_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

FROM Customers c
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
WHERE cc.card_id IN (
    SELECT ft.card_id

    GROUP BY ft.card_id
    HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) > 1000
);

FROM Customers c
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name
HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) > 1000

WITH card_totals AS (
    SELECT cc.card_id, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM "Financial_Transactions" ft
    JOIN "Customers_Cards" cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    GROUP BY cc.card_id
    HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) > 1000
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_first_name
FROM card_totals ct
JOIN "Customers_Cards" cc ON ct.card_id = cc.card_id
JOIN "Customers" c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id;

FROM Customers c
WHERE c.customer_id IN (

WITH TransactionSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        fc.customer_id,
        fc.card_id,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) as total_spending
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards fc ON ft.card_id = fc.card_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) = '2018'
    GROUP BY fc.customer_id, fc.card_id
),
Counted AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spending DESC) as rn
    FROM TransactionSummary
),
TopHalf AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM Counted
    WHERE rn <= total_count / 2
)
SELECT 
    cc.date_valid_from
FROM TopHalf th
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON th.card_id = cc.card_id
ORDER BY th.total_spending DESC

    WHERE strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) = '2018'
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
),

        customer_id,
        total_spending,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spending DESC) AS spending_rank,

)
